units.zh: 鐵失者，當英宗即位之初，以翰林學士承旨、宣徽院使，為太醫院使。
units.en: At the start of Emperor Yingzong's reign Tie Shi was Hanlin grand secretary and Huizheng Court commissioner, and was appointed superintendent of the Imperial Medical Academy.
units.literal: Tie Shi, at the beginning of Emperor Yingzong's accession, was Hanlin Academician Grand Secretary and Huizheng Court commissioner, and was made superintendent of the Imperial Medical Academy.

units.zh: 未逾月，特命領中都威衞指揮使。
units.en: Within a month he was specially ordered to take command of the Capital Might Guard.
units.literal: Within less than a month he was specially ordered to command the Capital Might Guard.

units.zh: 明年，改元至治，有珍珠燕服之賜。
units.en: The next year the era name was changed to Zhizhi, and he was granted a pearl swallow robe.
units.literal: The next year the era name was changed to Zhizhi, and he received the gift of a pearl swallow robe.

units.zh: 三月，特授光祿大夫、御史大夫，仍金虎符、忠翊侍衞親軍都指揮使，依前太醫院使。
units.en: In the third month he was specially made grand master of splendid happiness and grand censor, keeping his gold tiger tally, command of the Loyal and Supporting palace guard personal army, and post as imperial medical superintendent.
units.literal: In the third month he was specially granted Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Grand Censor, retaining the gold tiger tally and the posts of commander of the Loyal and Supporting Palace Guard Personal Army, and continuing as before as superintendent of the Imperial Medical Academy.

units.zh: 英宗嘗御鹿頂殿，謂鐵失曰：「徽政雖隸太皇太后，朕視之與諸司同，凡簿書宜悉令御史檢覈。」
units.en: Emperor Yingzong once held court at Deer Peak Hall and told Tie Shi, "Though Huizheng falls under the empress dowager, I treat it like any other office. All its accounts should be fully audited by the censors."
units.literal: Emperor Yingzong once held court at Deer Peak Hall and said to Tie Shi: "Though Huizheng is subordinate to the Empress Dowager, I regard it the same as the other offices; all accounts ought to be ordered examined in full by the censors."

units.zh: 既而又命領左右阿速衞。
units.en: Soon afterward he was again ordered to command the left and right Asud guards.
units.literal: Soon afterward he was again ordered to command the Left and Right Asud Guards.

units.zh: 冬十月，英宗親祀太廟，以中書左丞相拜住為亞獻官，鐵失為終獻官。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter Emperor Yingzong sacrificed in person at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, with central left chancellor Bayiju as secondary offering officer and Tie Shi as final offering officer.
units.literal: In the tenth month of winter Emperor Yingzong personally sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, appointing Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat Bayiju as secondary offering officer and Tie Shi as final offering officer.

units.zh: 明年冬十月，江南行臺御史大夫脫脫以疾請于朝，未得旨輒去職，鐵失奏罷之，杖六十七，謫居雲南。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter the following year, Tuo Tuo, the Jiangnan regional censor-in-chief, asked the court for sick leave. He quit his post before any reply arrived. Tie Shi had him dismissed, beaten sixty-seven strokes, and sent into exile in Yunnan.
units.literal: The next year, in the tenth month of winter, Tuo Tuo, Grand Censor of the Jiangnan Regional Secretariat, requested leave from court on grounds of illness; without obtaining an edict he abruptly left his post. Tie Shi memorialized to dismiss him; he was beaten sixty-seven strokes and banished to reside in Yunnan.

units.zh: 治書侍御史鎖南，鐵木迭兒之子也，罷為翰林侍講學士，鐵失奏復其職，英宗不允。
units.en: Suonan, an associate censor of the Secretariat, was Temuder's son. After his dismissal to a Hanlin lecturing post, Tie Shi asked that he be reinstated, but Emperor Yingzong refused.
units.literal: Suonan, Associate Censor of the Secretariat, was Temuder's son; he had been dismissed and made Hanlin Academician Explaining the Classics. Tie Shi memorialized to restore his office; Emperor Yingzong did not consent.

units.zh: 十二月，鐵失以御史大夫、忠翊親軍都指揮使、左右衛阿速親軍都指揮使、太醫院使，兼領廣惠司事。
units.en: In the twelfth month Tie Shi was appointed grand censor, commander of the Loyal and Supporting personal army and of the Asud guards of the left and right, superintendent of the Imperial Medical Academy, and concurrent head of the Broad Beneficence Office.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, Tie Shi held the posts of Grand Censor, Commander-in-Chief of the Loyal and Supporting Personal Army, Commander-in-Chief of the Left and Right Guards' Asud Personal Army, and Superintendent of the Imperial Medical Academy, and concurrently directed the affairs of the Broad Beneficence Office.

units.zh: 英宗嘗謂臺臣曰：「朕深居九重，臣下奸貪，民生疾苦，豈能周知，故用卿等為耳目。
units.en: Emperor Yingzong once told the censorate, "I live deep within the palace. How can I know every case of official corruption or every hardship among the people? That is why I rely on you as my eyes and ears.
units.literal: Emperor Yingzong once said to the censorate officials: "I dwell deep within the Ninefold Palaces; how could I thoroughly know the corruption and greed of subordinates or the hardships of the people's livelihood? Therefore I employ you as my eyes and ears.

units.zh: 曩者，鐵木迭兒貪蠹無厭，汝等拱默不言，其人雖死，宜籍其家，以懲後也。」
units.en: When Temuder was alive his greed knew no limit, yet you said nothing. He is dead now, but his estate should still be confiscated to warn future offenders."
units.literal: Formerly Temuder was insatiably corrupt; you folded your arms and remained silent. Though the man is dead, his household property ought to be registered and confiscated to warn those who come after."

units.zh: 又明年正月，申命大夫鐵失，振舉臺綱，詔諭中外。
units.en: In the first month of the year after next he again ordered Grand Censor Tie Shi to restore discipline in the censorate, with an edict announced at home and abroad.
units.literal: In the first month of the year after next, Grand Censor Tie Shi was again ordered to revive the standards of the censorate; an edict was proclaimed throughout the court and the realm.

units.zh: 既而御史臺請降旨開言路，英宗曰：「言路何嘗不開，但卿等選人未當爾。
units.en: The Censorate then asked for an edict opening the way for frank counsel. The emperor replied, "The way for counsel has never been closed. The problem is the men you choose.
units.literal: Soon afterward the Censorate requested an edict to open the avenue of remonstrance. Emperor Yingzong said: "When has the avenue of remonstrance not been open? It is only that your selections of men are not appropriate.

units.zh: 朕知嚮所劾者，率因宿怨，羅織成獄，加之以罪，遂玷其人，終身不得伸。
units.en: I know the men you have impeached were usually pursued over old grudges, with charges stitched together into cases until the accused were ruined and could never clear their names.
units.literal: I know that those impeached in the past were mostly pursued because of old grudges, with charges woven together into cases and crimes heaped upon them, so that the persons were stained and could not clear themselves for life.

units.zh: 監察御史嘗舉八思吉思可任大事，未幾，以貪墨伏誅。
units.en: A surveillance censor once recommended Basiji as fit for great responsibility, yet within a short time Basiji was executed for graft.
units.literal: A surveillance censor once recommended that Basiji could be entrusted with great affairs; before long he was executed for corruption.

units.zh: 若此者，言路選人當乎，否乎？」
units.en: Is that the kind of man you should be putting forward on the avenue of remonstrance?"
units.literal: In cases like this, are the selections for the avenue of remonstrance appropriate or not?"

units.zh: 時鐵木迭兒既死，罪惡日彰，英宗委任拜住為右丞相，振立紀綱，修舉廢墜，以進賢退不肖為急務。
units.en: By then Temuder was dead and his crimes were coming to light. Emperor Yingzong put Bayiju in charge as right chancellor to restore order, revive neglected institutions, and make promoting the worthy and removing the unfit his top priority.
units.literal: At that time Temuder was already dead and his crimes daily became manifest. Emperor Yingzong entrusted Bayiju as Right Chancellor to establish discipline, restore what had fallen into ruin, and make advancing the worthy and removing the unworthy his urgent task.

units.zh: 鐵失以姦黨不自安，潛蓄異圖。
units.en: Tie Shi, uneasy as a member of the corrupt faction, secretly laid other plans.
units.literal: Tie Shi, as a member of the corrupt faction, could not feel secure and secretly harbored a different design.

units.zh: 秋八月癸亥，英宗自上都南還，駐蹕南坡。
units.en: In the eighth month of autumn, on the guihai day, Emperor Yingzong returned south from Shangdu and halted at Nanpo.
units.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on the guihai day, Emperor Yingzong returned south from Shangdu and halted at Nanpo.

units.zh: 是夕，鐵失與知樞密院事也先鐵木兒、大司農失禿兒、前中書平章政事赤斤鐵木兒、前雲南行省平章政事完者、前治書侍御史鎖南、鐵失之弟宣徽使鎖南、典瑞院使脫火赤、樞密副使阿散、僉書樞密院事章台、衞士禿滿，及諸王按梯不花、孛羅、月魯鐵木兒、曲律不花、兀魯思不花等，以鐵失所領阿速衞兵為外應，殺右丞相拜住，而鐵失直犯禁幄，手弒英宗于臥所。
units.en: That night Tie Shi, together with privy council administrator Yesen Timur, Minister of Revenue Shitu'er, former central pingzhang Chijin Timur, former Yunnan pingzhang Wanzhe, former associate censor Suonan, Tie Shi's younger brother Huizheng commissioner Suonan, Ceremonial Regalia Court commissioner Tuohuochi, privy council vice director Asan, privy council secretary Zhangtai, guard Tumian, and the princes Atibuhua, Boluo, Yuelu Timur, Qulvuhua, and Ulusibuhua, used Tie Shi's Asud guards as accomplices, killed right chancellor Bayiju, then burst into the forbidden tent and personally assassinated Emperor Yingzong in his sleeping quarters.
units.literal: That evening Tie Shi, together with Privy Council administrator Yesen Timur, Minister of Revenue Shitu'er, former Pingzhang of the Central Secretariat Chijin Timur, former Pingzhang of the Yunnan Branch Secretariat Wanzhe, former Associate Censor Suonan, Tie Shi's younger brother Huizheng Court commissioner Suonan, Ceremonial Regalia Court commissioner Tuohuochi, Vice Director of the Privy Council Asan, Privy Council Secretary Zhangtai, guard Tumian, and the princes Atibuhua, Boluo, Yuelu Timur, Qulvuhua, Ulusibuhua, and others, using the Asud guard troops Tie Shi commanded as external support, killed Right Chancellor Bayiju; Tie Shi then directly breached the forbidden tent and personally assassinated Emperor Yingzong in his sleeping quarters.

units.zh: 九月四日，晉王即位，鐵失及其黨皆伏誅。
units.en: On the fourth day of the ninth month the Prince of Jin took the throne; Tie Shi and his confederates were all executed.
units.literal: On the fourth day of the ninth month the Prince of Jin ascended the throne; Tie Shi and his faction were all executed.

units.zh: 孛羅帖木兒，荅失八都魯之子也。
units.en: Boluo Timur was the son of Dashi-Baturu.
units.literal: Boluo Timur was the son of Dashi-Baturu.

units.zh: 從父討賊，屢立戰功，其語見父傳。
units.en: He followed his father against rebels and won repeated victories; those campaigns are recorded in his father's biography.
units.literal: He followed his father in suppressing bandits and repeatedly achieved military merit; the account appears in his father's biography.

units.zh: 父既歿，孛羅帖木兒引兵退駐井陘口。
units.en: After his father's death Boluo Timur withdrew his army and encamped at Jingxing Pass.
units.literal: After his father died, Boluo Timur led his troops back and encamped at Jingxing Pass.

units.zh: 至正十八年正月，命孛羅帖木兒為河南行省平章政事，仍緫領其父元管諸軍。
units.en: In the first month of Zhizheng 18 he was made pingzhang of the Henan branch secretariat while continuing to command all the forces his father had once held.
units.literal: In the first month of the eighteenth year of Zhizheng, Boluo Timur was appointed Pingzhang of the Henan Branch Secretariat and still commanded overall the various armies his father had originally administered.

units.zh: 三月，擊劉福通於衛輝，走之，進克濮州。
units.en: In the third month he attacked Liu Futong at Weihui, routed him, and went on to take Puzhou.
units.literal: In the third month he attacked Liu Futong at Weihui, drove him off, and advanced to capture Puzhou.

units.zh: 四月，屯兵真定。
units.en: In the fourth month he encamped at Zhending.
units.literal: In the fourth month he encamped his troops at Zhending.

units.zh: 六月，自武安由彭城邀截沙劉等，敗之。
units.en: In the sixth month he marched from Wu'an through Pengcheng, intercepted Sha Liu and his followers, and defeated them.
units.literal: In the sixth month, setting out from Wu'an and passing through Pengcheng, he intercepted Sha Liu and others and defeated them.

units.zh: 九月，命統領諸軍夾攻曹州。
units.en: In the ninth month he was ordered to lead a converging assault on Caozhou.
units.literal: In the ninth month he was ordered to command all armies in a converging attack on Caozhou.

units.zh: 十月，遣參政匡福統苗軍自西門入，孛羅帖木兒自北門入，四門並進，克復曹州，擒殺偽官武宰相、仇知院，獲偽印信金牌等物。
units.en: In the tenth month he sent Vice Administrator Kuang Fu with Miao troops through the west gate while he himself entered from the north. All four gates attacked together, Caozhou was retaken, the rebel officials Wu the chancellor and Qiu the director were captured and killed, and false seals, gold tallies, and other booty were seized.
units.literal: In the tenth month he sent Vice Administrator Kuang Fu to lead the Miao army in through the west gate while Boluo Timur entered through the north gate; all four gates advanced together, recovered Caozhou, captured and killed the rebel officials the false Chancellor Wu and the false Director Qiu, and obtained false seals, gold tallies, and other objects.

units.zh: 十九年二月，過代州，收山東潰將孟本周諸軍。
units.en: In the second month of the nineteenth year he passed through Daizhou and took over the forces of the routed Shandong commander Meng Benzhou.
units.literal: In the second month of the nineteenth year he passed through Daizhou and gathered the troops of the Shandong routed general Meng Benzhou.

units.zh: 三月，詔孛羅帖木兒移兵至大同，置大都督兵農司，專督屯種，以孛羅帖木兒領之。
units.en: In the third month he was ordered to move his army to Datong. A metropolitan military-agricultural commission was set up to oversee garrison farming, with Boluo Timur placed in charge.
units.literal: In the third month an edict ordered Boluo Timur to move his army to Datong, established the Datong Military-Agricultural Commission to supervise garrison farming exclusively, and put Boluo Timur in charge of it.

units.zh: 當月領兵豐州、雲內，與關先生戰，關軍奔潰。
units.en: That same month he led troops at Fengzhou and Yunnei, fought Master Guan's forces, and routed them.
units.literal: That same month he led troops at Fengzhou and Yunnei, fought with Master Guan, and Guan's army fled in rout.

units.zh: 時有楊誠者，據蔚州，六月，詔遣平章月魯不花、樞密同知八剌火者，督兵捕之，七月，圍其城。
units.en: Yang Cheng then held Weizhou. In the sixth month Pingzhang Yuelu Buhua and privy council vice director Balahuozhe were sent to hunt him down, and in the seventh month they besieged the city.
units.literal: At that time Yang Cheng held Weizhou. In the sixth month an edict sent Pingzhang Yuelu Buhua and Vice Director of the Privy Council Balahuozhe to supervise troops in capturing him; in the seventh month they besieged his city.

units.zh: 俄有旨，命回兵。
units.en: Soon an edict arrived ordering the troops to withdraw.
units.literal: Soon there came an edict ordering the troops to withdraw.

units.zh: 十一月，再命勦捕。
units.en: In the eleventh month he was again ordered to suppress Yang Cheng.
units.literal: In the eleventh month he was again ordered to suppress and capture them.

units.zh: 二十年正月，孛羅帖木兒追誠至飛狐縣東關，誠棄軍遁，降其潰卒，回駐大同。
units.en: In the first month of the twentieth year Boluo Timur pursued Cheng to the eastern pass of Feihu County. Cheng abandoned his army and fled. Boluo Timur accepted the surrender of the routed troops and returned to encamp at Datong.
units.literal: In the first month of the twentieth year Boluo Timur pursued Cheng to the eastern pass of Feihu County; Cheng abandoned his army and fled, Boluo Timur accepted the surrender of his routed soldiers, and returned to encamp at Datong.

units.zh: 二月，除中書平章政事。
units.en: In the second month he was made pingzhang of the central secretariat.
units.literal: In the second month he was appointed Pingzhang of the Central Secretariat.

units.zh: 三月，命討上都程思忠，兵次興和，思忠奔潰。
units.en: In the third month he was ordered to campaign against Cheng Sizhong at Shangdu. When his army reached Xinghe, Sizhong fled in rout.
units.literal: In the third month he was ordered to campaign against Cheng Sizhong at Shangdu; when his army reached Xinghe, Sizhong fled in rout.

units.zh: 七月，擊銑田豐偽將王士誠於臺州。
units.en: In the seventh month he attacked Wang Shicheng, a rebel general of Tian Feng, at Taizhou.
units.literal: In the seventh month he attacked Tian Feng's false general Wang Shicheng at Taizhou.

units.zh: 詔緫領一應達達、漢人諸軍，便宜行事。
units.en: He was ordered to take overall command of all Mongol and Han forces and to act at his discretion.
units.literal: An edict ordered him to command overall all Mongol and Han armies and to act according to circumstances.

units.zh: 八月，命守石嶺關以北，察罕帖木兒守石嶺關以南。
units.en: In the eighth month he was ordered to hold the territory north of Shiling Pass while Chaghan Timur held the south.
units.literal: In the eighth month he was ordered to guard the area north of Shiling Pass while Chaghan Timur guarded the area south of it.

units.zh: 九月，孛羅帖木兒欲得冀寧，遣兵自石嶺關直趨圍其城，三日，復退屯交城。
units.en: In the ninth month Boluo Timur, wanting Jining for himself, sent troops straight through Shiling Pass to besiege the city. After three days he withdrew and encamped at Jiaocheng.
units.literal: In the ninth month Boluo Timur wished to obtain Jining, sent troops straight from Shiling Pass to surround its city, and after three days withdrew again to encamp at Jiaocheng.

units.zh: 十月，詔孛羅帖木兒守冀寧，遣保保、殷興祖、高脫因倍道趨之，守者不納。
units.en: In the tenth month an edict put Boluo Timur in charge of Jining and sent Baobao, Yin Xingzu, and Gao Tuoyin by forced marches to take it, but the garrison refused them entry.
units.literal: In the tenth month an edict ordered Boluo Timur to guard Jining and sent Baobao, Yin Xingzu, and Gao Tuoyin by rapid marches to hurry there, but the defenders would not admit them.

units.zh: 察罕帖木兒遣鎖住、陳秉直以兵來爭，孛羅帖木兒部將脫列伯戰敗之。
units.en: Chaghan Timur sent Suozhu and Chen Bingzhi to contest the place, but Boluo Timur's general Teliebo defeated them.
units.literal: Chaghan Timur sent Suozhu and Chen Bingzhi with troops to contest it; Boluo Timur's subordinate general Teliebo defeated them in battle.

units.zh: 二十一年正月，命平章荅失帖木兒、參政七十往諭解之，孛羅帖木兒罷兵還鎮。
units.en: In the first month of the twenty-first year Pingzhang Dashi Timur and Vice Administrator Qishi were sent to negotiate a settlement, and Boluo Timur withdrew his troops to his base.
units.literal: In the first month of the twenty-first year Pingzhang Dashi Timur and Vice Administrator Qishi were ordered to go and instruct a settlement; Boluo Timur ceased hostilities and returned to his commandery.

units.zh: 九月，命孛羅帖木兒於保定以東、河間以南屯田。
units.en: In the ninth month he was ordered to establish garrison farms east of Baoding and south of Hejian.
units.literal: In the ninth month Boluo Timur was ordered to conduct garrison farming east of Baoding and south of Hejian.

units.zh: 二十二年二月，偽平章左李遣楊榮祖至大同降。
units.en: In the second month of the twenty-second year the rebel pingzhang Zuo Li sent Yang Rongzu to Datong to surrender.
units.literal: In the second month of the twenty-second year the false Pingzhang Zuo Li sent Yang Rongzu to Datong to surrender.

units.zh: 三月，孛羅帖木兒遣裨將也速不花等招兵五萬，戍大同。
units.en: In the third month Boluo Timur sent lieutenants such as Yesu Buhua to raise fifty thousand men to garrison Datong.
units.literal: In the third month Boluo Timur sent his lieutenant generals Yesu Buhua and others to recruit fifty thousand troops to garrison Datong.

units.zh: 陞孛羅帖木兒太尉、中書平章，位居第一。
units.en: Boluo Timur was promoted to grand marshal and central pingzhang, taking first rank among them.
units.literal: Boluo Timur was promoted to Grand Marshal and Pingzhang of the Central Secretariat, ranking first in precedence.

units.zh: 張良弼來受節制，李思齊遣兵攻良弼于武功，良弼伏兵大破之。
units.en: Zhang Liangbi placed himself under his command. When Li Siqi sent troops against Liangbi at Wugong, Liangbi ambushed them and won a crushing victory.
units.literal: Zhang Liangbi came to accept his command; Li Siqi sent troops to attack Liangbi at Wugong, and Liangbi ambushed them and inflicted a great defeat.

units.zh: 二十三年十月，孛羅帖木兒復南侵擴廓帖木兒所守地，遂據真定。
units.en: In the tenth month of the twenty-third year Boluo Timur again invaded south into Köke Timur's territory and seized Zhending.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the twenty-third year Boluo Timur again invaded south into the territory guarded by Köke Timur and then occupied Zhending.

units.zh: 初，朝廷既黜御史大夫老的沙，安置東勝州，帝別遣宦官密諭孛羅帖木兒，令留軍中。
units.en: Earlier the court had dismissed Grand Censor Laodesha and sent him to Dongsheng Prefecture. The emperor then secretly ordered Boluo Timur through a eunuch to keep Laodesha with his army.
units.literal: Earlier the court had dismissed Grand Censor Laodesha and sent him into residence at Dongsheng Prefecture. The emperor separately sent a eunuch with secret instructions to Boluo Timur to keep him in the army.

units.zh: 而皇太子累遣官索之，孛羅帖木兒匿不發。
units.en: The heir apparent repeatedly sent officials to demand his surrender, but Boluo Timur hid him and refused to hand him over.
units.literal: But the heir apparent repeatedly sent officials to demand him, and Boluo Timur concealed him and would not hand him over.

units.zh: 二十四年正月，孛羅帖木兒陰使人殺其叔父左丞亦只兒不花，佯為不知，往弔不哭。
units.en: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year Boluo Timur secretly had his uncle, Left Chancellor Yijir Buhua, murdered, then feigned ignorance and attended the mourning without shedding a tear.
units.literal: In the first month of the twenty-fourth year Boluo Timur secretly had men kill his uncle, Left Chancellor Yijir Buhua, then pretended ignorance and went to offer condolences without weeping.

units.zh: 朝廷知其跋扈，又以匿老的沙事，三月辛卯，詔罷孛羅帖木兒兵權，四川安置。
units.en: Knowing how overbearing he had become, and because he had hidden Laodesha, on the xinmao day of the third month the court stripped him of military command and ordered him sent to Sichuan.
units.literal: The court knew his arrogance, and because of the matter of concealing Laodesha, on the xinmao day of the third month an edict stripped Boluo Timur of military authority and sent him into residence in Sichuan.

units.zh: 孛羅帖木兒殺使者拒命，遣部將會禿堅帖木兒提兵犯闕，揚言索右丞相搠思監、資正院使朴不花二人。
units.en: Boluo Timur killed the envoy, defied the order, and sent his general Toqto'a Timur to march on the capital, openly demanding the surrender of Right Chancellor Bodaijian and Correct Resources director Pak Buha.
units.literal: Boluo Timur killed the envoy and defied the order, sent his subordinate general Toqto'a Timur to lead troops in assaulting the imperial precincts, and openly declared he was demanding the two men Right Chancellor Bodaijian and Director of the Correct Resources Office Pak Buha.

units.zh: 先是，朝廷立衛屯田，嘗命中書右丞也先不花提督，與禿堅帖木兒分院之地相近，因擾及其親里，搆成嫌隙，也先不花乃譖禿堅帖木兒詆毀朝政，孛羅帖木兒與禿堅帖木兒相友善，且知其誣，遣人白其非罪。
units.en: Earlier the court had set up guard garrison farms under Right Vice Chancellor Yesen Buhua, whose district bordered that of Toqto'a Timur. Yesen Buhua's men disturbed Toqto'a Timur's kin and home district, breeding resentment until Yesen Buhua accused Toqto'a Timur of slandering the government. Boluo Timur, who was friendly with Toqto'a Timur and knew the charge was false, sent word that he was innocent.
units.literal: Earlier the court had established guard garrison farms and once appointed Right Vice Chancellor Yesen Buhua to supervise them; his district was close to that assigned to Toqto'a Timur, and because of disturbances to the latter's kin and home district a grudge was formed. Yesen Buhua then slandered Toqto'a Timur for defaming court policy. Boluo Timur was on friendly terms with Toqto'a Timur and knew the accusation was false, and sent men to report that he was not guilty.

units.zh: 皇太子以孛羅帖木兒握兵跋扈，今乃與禿堅帖木兒交通，又匿不軌之臣，遂與丞相搠思監議，請詔削其官，分其兵授四川省丞相察罕不花領之。
units.en: The heir apparent, seeing Boluo Timur's arrogance with troops in hand, his collusion with Toqto'a Timur, and his concealment of a disloyal minister, discussed with Chancellor Bodaijian a request to strip his offices and divide his army, giving command to Sichuan branch chancellor Chaghan Buhua.
units.literal: The heir apparent, because Boluo Timur held troops and acted arrogantly, now associated with Toqto'a Timur and also concealed a disloyal minister, then discussed with Chancellor Bodaijian and requested an edict to strip his offices and divide his troops, assigning them to Sichuan Branch Secretariat Chancellor Chaghan Buhua to command.

units.zh: 孛羅帖木兒謂非帝意，故不聽命，舉兵助禿堅帖木兒。
units.en: Boluo Timur claimed the order did not reflect the emperor's will, refused to obey, and raised troops to aid Toqto'a Timur.
units.literal: Boluo Timur said this was not the emperor's intent and therefore would not obey; he raised troops to assist Toqto'a Timur.

units.zh: 四月壬寅，入居庸，乙巳，至清河列營，將犯闕。
units.en: On the renyin day of the fourth month he entered Juyong Pass. On the yisi day he reached Qinghe and pitched camp, preparing to assault the capital.
units.literal: On the renyin day of the fourth month he entered Juyong Pass; on the yisi day he reached Qinghe and arrayed camps, about to assault the imperial precincts.

units.zh: 帝遣達達國師、蠻子院使往問故，乃命屏搠思監于嶺北，竄朴不花于甘肅，實執送與之。
units.en: The emperor sent the Dada imperial preceptor and the Manshi court commissioner to ask his grievance, then ordered Bodaijian sent to Lingbei and Pak Buha banished to Gansu—in fact both men were seized and handed over to him.
units.literal: The emperor sent the Dada Imperial Preceptor and the Manshi Court Commissioner to inquire the reason, then ordered Bodaijian removed to Lingbei and Pak Buha banished to Gansu—in fact they were seized and delivered to him.

units.zh: 庚戌，禿堅帖木兒自健德門入，見帝延春閣，慟哭請罪，帝賜宴慰勉，詔赦其罪。
units.en: On the gengxu day Toqto'a Timur entered through Jiande Gate, saw the emperor at the Yanchun Pavilion, wept and begged forgiveness. The emperor gave him a feast of consolation and issued an edict pardoning his crimes.
units.literal: On the gengxu day Toqto'a Timur entered through Jiande Gate, saw the emperor at the Yanchun Pavilion, wept and begged forgiveness; the emperor bestowed a feast to comfort and encourage him and issued an edict pardoning his crime.

units.zh: 仍以孛羅帖木兒為太保、中書平章，兼知樞密院事，守禦大同；
units.en: Boluo Timur was again made grand guardian and central pingzhang, with concurrent charge of privy council affairs, to guard Datong;
units.literal: Boluo Timur was again made Grand Guardian, Pingzhang of the Central Secretariat, and concurrently Manager of the Privy Council affairs, to guard and defend Datong;

units.zh: 以禿堅帖木兒為中書平章政事。
units.en: and Toqto'a Timur was made central pingzhang.
units.literal: Toqto'a Timur was made Pingzhang of the Central Secretariat.

units.zh: 辛亥，孛羅帖木兒還大同，皇太子恚怒不已，再徵擴廓帖木兒兵，保障京師。
units.en: On the xinhai day Boluo Timur returned to Datong. The heir apparent, still furious, again summoned Köke Timur's troops to secure the capital.
units.literal: On the xinhai day Boluo Timur returned to Datong. The heir apparent's rage did not cease, and he again summoned Köke Timur's troops to secure the capital.

units.zh: 五月，詔擴廓帖木兒緫兵，調諸道軍分討大同。
units.en: In the fifth month Köke Timur was ordered to take overall command and mobilize forces from every circuit for a joint campaign against Datong.
units.literal: In the fifth month an edict ordered Köke Timur to command troops overall and mobilize armies from all circuits to campaign separately against Datong.

units.zh: 擴廓帖木兒自其父察罕帖木兒在時，與孛羅帖木兒連年相讎殺，朝廷累命官講和，二軍已還兵，各守其地。
units.en: Ever since his father Chaghan Timur's day, Köke Timur and Boluo Timur had been locked in a feud of mutual slaughter. The court had repeatedly sent mediators, and both armies had withdrawn to their own territories.
units.literal: Since the time when his father Chaghan Timur was alive, Köke Timur and Boluo Timur had for years killed one another in feud; the court repeatedly sent officials to negotiate peace, and the two armies had already withdrawn, each guarding its own territory.

units.zh: 至是，擴廓帖木兒乃大發兵，諸道夾攻大同，調麾下鎖住守護京師，兵不滿萬，以其部下青軍楊同僉守居庸，擴廓帖木兒自將至太原，調督諸軍。
units.en: Now Köke Timur mobilized on a large scale. Armies from every circuit converged on Datong. He left Suozhu to guard the capital with fewer than ten thousand men, posted his Qing Army commander Yang Tongqian at Juyong, and marched in person to Taiyuan to direct the campaign.
units.literal: At this point Köke Timur then mobilized troops on a large scale; armies from all circuits converged on Datong. He transferred his subordinate Suozhu to guard the capital with fewer than ten thousand troops, placed his subordinate Qing Army commander Yang Tongqian to guard Juyong, and Köke Timur himself led the army to Taiyuan to direct and supervise the various forces.

units.zh: 七月，孛羅帖木兒率兵，與禿堅帖木兒、老的沙等復犯闕，京師震駭。
units.en: In the seventh month Boluo Timur marched again on the capital with Toqto'a Timur, Laodesha, and others, throwing the city into panic.
units.literal: In the seventh month Boluo Timur led troops, and together with Toqto'a Timur, Laodesha, and others again assaulted the imperial precincts, throwing the capital into alarm.

units.zh: 丙戌，皇太子親統兵迎於清河，丞相也速、詹事不蘭奚軍於昌平，也速軍士無鬪志，青軍楊同僉被殺於居庸，不蘭奚戰敗走，皇太子亦馳入城。
units.en: On the bingxu day the heir apparent led troops in person to meet them at Qinghe, while Chancellor Yeshu and household superintendent Buranxi took position at Changping. Yeshu's men would not fight. Yang Tongqian was killed at Juyong, Buranxi was routed, and the heir apparent galloped back into the city.
units.literal: On the bingxu day the heir apparent personally commanded troops to meet them at Qinghe; Chancellor Yeshu and Household Superintendent Buranxi stationed armies at Changping. Yeshu's soldiers had no fighting spirit; Qing Army commander Yang Tongqian was killed at Juyong; Buranxi was defeated and fled; the heir apparent also galloped into the city.

units.zh: 丁亥夜，鎖住脅東宮官僚從太子出奔太原。
units.en: That night Suozhu forced the Eastern Palace staff to flee with the heir apparent to Taiyuan.
units.literal: On the night of the dinghai day Suozhu coerced the Eastern Palace officials to follow the heir apparent in flight to Taiyuan.

units.zh: 戊子，孛羅帖木兒兵至，駐健德門外，欲追襲皇太子，老的沙力止之。
units.en: On the wuzi day Boluo Timur's army arrived and camped outside Jiande Gate. He wanted to pursue the heir apparent, but Laodesha strongly dissuaded him.
units.literal: On the wuzi day Boluo Timur's troops arrived and encamped outside Jiande Gate; he wished to pursue and strike the heir apparent, but Laodesha strenuously stopped him.

units.zh: 三人入見帝宣文閣，泣拜訴冤，帝亦為之泣，乃賜宴。
units.en: The three men entered the Xuanwen Pavilion, wept and bowed to plead their case, and the emperor wept with them before granting a feast.
units.literal: The three men entered to see the emperor at the Xuanwen Pavilion, wept and bowed to plead their grievance, and the emperor also wept for them, then bestowed a feast.

units.zh: 庚寅，就命孛羅帖木兒太保、中書左丞相，老的沙中書平章政事，禿堅帖木兒御史大夫。
units.en: On the gengyin day Boluo Timur was made grand guardian and left chancellor on the spot, Laodesha central pingzhang, and Toqto'a Timur grand censor.
units.literal: On the gengyin day Boluo Timur was immediately appointed Grand Guardian and Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat, Laodesha Pingzhang of the Central Secretariat, and Toqto'a Timur Grand Censor.

units.zh: 部屬將士，布列臺省，緫攬國柄。
units.en: Their officers and soldiers filled the censorate and secretariat offices and seized control of the government.
units.literal: Subordinate generals and soldiers were deployed throughout the censorate and secretariat offices, grasping overall control of state power.

units.zh: 八月壬寅，詔加孛羅帖木兒開府儀同三司、上柱國、錄軍國重事、太保、中書右丞相，節制天下軍馬。
units.en: On the renyin day of the eighth month Boluo Timur was further honored as commissioner equal to the Three Dukes, upper pillar of the state, recorder of weighty state and military affairs, grand guardian, and right chancellor, with command over all armies under heaven.
units.literal: On the renyin day of the eighth month an edict added to Boluo Timur the titles Opening the Office with Equal Ceremony to the Three Dukes, Upper Pillar of the State, Recorder of Weighty State and Military Affairs, Grand Guardian, and Right Chancellor of the Central Secretariat, with control over all armies and horses under heaven.

units.zh: 數月間，誅狎臣禿魯帖木兒、波迪哇兒禡等，罷三宮不急造作，沙汰宦官，減省錢糧，禁西番僧人佛事。
units.en: Within a few months he executed favored ministers such as Tulü Timur and Bodaiwarta, halted nonessential construction in the three palaces, purged eunuchs, cut spending, and banned Buddhist rites by Tibetan monks.
units.literal: Within several months he executed intimate ministers Tulü Timur, Bodaiwarta, and others, halted non-urgent construction in the three palaces, sifted out eunuchs, reduced expenditures of money and grain, and forbade Buddhist services by Tibetan monks.

units.zh: 數遣使請皇太子還朝，使至太原，拘留不報。
units.en: He repeatedly asked the heir apparent to return to court, but every envoy sent to Taiyuan was detained without reply.
units.literal: He repeatedly sent envoys requesting the heir apparent to return to court; when the envoys reached Taiyuan they were detained and no reply was sent.

units.zh: 二十五年，皇太子在外，日夜謀除內難，承制調遣嶺北、甘肅、遼陽、陝西及擴廓帖木兒等軍，進討孛羅帖木兒。
units.en: In the twenty-fifth year the heir apparent, still abroad, plotted day and night to remove the men who held the capital. Acting under imperial commission, he mobilized forces from Lingbei, Gansu, Liaoyang, Shaanxi, and Köke Timur's army for a campaign against Boluo Timur.
units.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, while the heir apparent was abroad, day and night he plotted to remove the internal peril, and under imperial commission mobilized armies of Lingbei, Gansu, Liaoyang, Shaanxi, and Köke Timur to advance and campaign against Boluo Timur.

units.zh: 孛羅帖木兒怒，出皇后于外，幽置百日。
units.en: Boluo Timur, enraged, sent the empress out of the palace and kept her under confinement for a hundred days.
units.literal: Boluo Timur in anger sent the empress outside and confined her for a hundred days.

units.zh: 遣禿堅帖木兒率軍討上都附皇太子者，調也速南禦擴廓帖木兒軍。
units.en: He sent Toqto'a Timur to suppress Shangdu supporters of the heir apparent and shifted Yeshu south to block Köke Timur's advance.
units.literal: He sent Toqto'a Timur to lead troops in suppressing those at Shangdu who adhered to the heir apparent, and transferred Yeshu south to resist Köke Timur's army.

units.zh: 也速次良鄉不進，而歸永平，遣人西連太原，東連遼陽，軍聲大振。
units.en: Yeshu halted at Liangxiang without advancing, then withdrew to Yongping and sent envoys to link with Taiyuan in the west and Liaoyang in the east, until his army's reputation rose sharply.
units.literal: Yeshu halted at Liangxiang and did not advance, then returned to Yongping, sent men to link west with Taiyuan and east with Liaoyang, and his army's renown greatly swelled.

units.zh: 孛羅帖木兒患之，遣驍將姚伯顏不花統兵出禦，至通州，河溢，營虹橋以待，也速出其不意，襲而破之，擒姚伯顏，殺之。
units.en: Alarmed, Boluo Timur sent his fierce general Yao Bayan Buhua to meet him. At Tongzhou the river was in flood, and Yao Bayan Buhua encamped at Hongqiao to wait. Yeshu surprised him, routed his force, captured Yao Bayan Buhua, and executed him.
units.literal: Boluo Timur was troubled by this and sent his fierce general Yao Bayan Buhua to command troops out to resist; reaching Tongzhou, the river overflowed and he encamped at Hongqiao to wait. Yeshu caught him unawares, struck and broke his force, captured Yao Bayan, and killed him.

units.zh: 孛羅帖木兒大恐，自將出通州，三日大雨而還。
units.en: Boluo Timur was terrified and marched out to Tongzhou in person, but after three days of heavy rain he turned back.
units.literal: Boluo Timur was greatly afraid and personally led troops out to Tongzhou; after three days of heavy rain he returned.

units.zh: 孛羅帖木兒先嘗以自疑殺其將保安，既又失姚伯顏，鬱鬱不樂，乃日與老的沙飲宴，荒淫無度，酗酒殺人，喜怒不測，人皆畏忌。
units.en: Boluo Timur had already killed his general Bao'an on suspicion. After losing Yao Bayan Buhua as well, he sank into gloom and spent his days feasting and drinking with Laodesha. He gave himself to debauchery, drank until he killed men at whim, and ruled by unpredictable fits of rage until all feared him.
units.literal: Boluo Timur had earlier killed his general Bao'an out of suspicion; now he had again lost Yao Bayan Buhua, was depressed and unhappy, and then daily feasted and drank with Laodesha, indulging in debauchery without limit, getting drunk and killing people, with joy and anger unpredictable, so that everyone feared him.

units.zh: 威順王子和尚，受帝密旨，與徐士本謀，結勇士上都馬、金那海、伯顏達兒、帖古思不花、火兒忽達、洪寶寶等，陰圖刺之。
units.en: Heshang, son of the Prince of Weishun, received a secret order from the emperor and plotted with Xu Shiben to gather brave men—Shangdu Ma, Jin Nahai, Bayan Da'er, Tegus Buhua, Huo'erhuda, Hong Baobao, and others—for a secret attempt on his life.
units.literal: Heshang, son of the Prince of Weishun, received the emperor's secret order and plotted with Xu Shiben, joining brave men Shangdu Ma, Jin Nahai, Bayan Da'er, Tegus Buhua, Huo'erhuda, Hong Baobao, and others to scheme in secret to assassinate him.

units.zh: 七月乙酉，值禿堅帖木兒遣人來告上都之捷，孛羅帖木兒起入奏，行至延春閣李樹下，伯顏達兒自衆中奮出，斫孛羅帖木兒，中其腦，上都馬及金那海等競前斫死。
units.en: On the yiyou day of the seventh month, as Boluo Timur rose to report Toqto'a Timur's victory dispatch from Shangdu, he passed beneath the plum tree at the Yanchun Pavilion. Bayan Da'er sprang from the crowd and struck him on the head. Shangdu Ma, Jin Nahai, and the others rushed in and hacked him to death.
units.literal: On the yiyou day of the seventh month, when Toqto'a Timur sent men to report victory at Shangdu, Boluo Timur rose to enter and memorialize; as he walked to beneath the plum tree at the Yanchun Pavilion, Bayan Da'er leapt out from the crowd, hacked Boluo Timur, and struck his brain; Shangdu Ma and Jin Nahai and others rushed forward together and hacked him to death.

units.zh: 老的沙傷額，趨出，得馬，走其家，擁孛羅帖木兒母妻及其子天寶奴北遁。
units.en: Laodesha was wounded on the forehead, fled on horseback to his house, and escorted Boluo Timur's mother, wife, and son Tianbaonu north in flight.
units.literal: Laodesha was wounded on the forehead, hurried out, obtained a horse, fled to his house, and escorted Boluo Timur's mother, wife, and his son Tianbaonu in flight north.

units.zh: 有旨令民間盡殺其部黨。
units.en: An edict ordered the people to kill every member of his faction.
units.literal: There came an edict ordering the populace to kill all his faction to the last man.

units.zh: 明日，遣使函孛羅帖木兒首級往太原，詔皇太子還朝。
units.en: The next day envoys carried Boluo Timur's head in a box to Taiyuan and ordered the heir apparent to return to court.
units.literal: The next day envoys were sent bearing Boluo Timur's head in a box to Taiyuan, and an edict ordered the heir apparent to return to court.

units.zh: 諸道兵聞詔，罷歸。
units.en: Armies from every circuit, hearing the edict, stood down and returned home.
units.literal: Armies from the various circuits, hearing the edict, ceased campaigning and returned.

units.zh: 九月，皇太子朝京師。
units.en: In the ninth month the heir apparent returned to the capital.
units.literal: In the ninth month the heir apparent attended court at the capital.

units.zh: 十二月，獲禿堅帖木兒、老的沙，皆伏誅。
units.en: In the twelfth month Toqto'a Timur and Laodesha were captured and executed.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Toqto'a Timur and Laodesha were captured and both were executed.

units.zh: 而察罕既取汴梁，遂遣子擴廓討東平，脅降田豐、王士誠，乘勝定山東。
units.en: After Chaghan took Bianliang, he sent his son Köke Temür against Dongping, forced Tian Feng and Wang Shicheng to submit, and pacified Shandong in the wake of victory.
units.literal: After Chaghan had taken Bianliang, he then sent his son Köke Temür to campaign against Dongping, coerced the surrender of Tian Feng and Wang Shicheng, and following victory pacified Shandong.

units.zh: 元以兵柄付擴廓，圍城數重，猱頭等告急。
units.en: The Yuan gave military command to Köke Temür, who laid siege in concentric rings; Yaotou sent urgent appeals for aid.
units.literal: The Yuan entrusted military authority to Köke Temür, who besieged the city in many rings; Yaotou and the others sent urgent appeals for help.

units.zh: 白不信、大刀敖、李喜喜陷興元，遂入鳳翔，屢為察罕帖木兒、李思齊所破，走入蜀。
units.en: Bai Buxin, Dadao Ao, and Li Xixi took Xingyuan and entered Fengxiang, but were repeatedly defeated by Chaghan Temür and Li Siqi and driven into Sichuan.
units.literal: Bai Buxin, Dadao Ao, and Li Xixi took Xingyuan, then entered Fengxiang; repeatedly they were broken by Chaghan Temür and Li Siqi and fled into Shu.

units.zh: 福通計無所出，挾林兒從百騎開東門遁還安豐，後宮官屬子女及符璽印章寶貨盡沒於察罕。
units.en: Futong, at his wits' end, fled through the east gate with Lin'er and a hundred horsemen back to Anfeng; the harem, officials, children, seals, and treasures all fell to Chaghan.
units.literal: Futong, with no plan left, took Lin'er with a hundred horsemen, opened the east gate, and fled back to Anfeng; the harem, officials, sons and daughters, seals, tallies, and treasures all fell into Chaghan's hands.

units.zh: 二十二年六月，豐、士誠乘閑刺殺察罕，入益都。
units.en: In the sixth month of year 22 (1362), Feng and Shicheng assassinated Chaghan when his guard was down and entered Yidu.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-second year Feng and Shicheng seized an opening and assassinated Chaghan, then entered Yidu.

units.zh: 及察罕帖木兒數破賊，盡復關、隴，是年五月大發秦、晉之師會汴城下，屯杏花營，諸軍環城而壘。
units.en: After Chaghan Temür had repeatedly defeated the rebels and recovered Guanzhong and Longyou, in the fifth month of that year he massed Qin and Jin armies below Bianliang, encamped at Apricot Blossom Camp, and ringed the city with siege works.
units.literal: When Chaghan Temür had repeatedly broken the rebels and wholly recovered Guan and Long, in the fifth month of that year he greatly dispatched Qin and Jin armies to assemble below Bian city, encamped at Apricot Blossom Camp, and the various armies ringed the city with fortifications.

units.zh: 受密旨，與儒士徐士本謀，交結勇士上都馬、金那海、伯顏達兒、帖古思不花、火你忽都、洪寶寶、黃哈剌八禿、龍從雲，陰圖刺孛羅帖木兒。
units.en: By secret edict he plotted with the scholar Xu Shiben and won over the warriors Shangdu Ma, Jin Naihai, Bayan Da'er, Tegus Buhua, Ho Nihudu, Hong Baobao, Huang Halabat, and Long Congyun to lay a hidden plan to kill Boluo Temür.
units.literal: Receiving a secret edict, he plotted with the scholar Xu Shiben and joined with the brave men Shangdu Ma, Jin Naihai, Bayan Da'er, Tegus Buhua, Ho Nihudu, Hong Baobao, Huang Halabat, and Long Congyun to scheme in secret to assassinate Boluo Temür.

units.zh: 至正二十四年，孛羅帖木兒稱兵犯闕，遂為中書右丞相，總握國柄，恣為淫虐。
units.en: In the twenty-fourth year of Zhizheng Boluo Temür marched on the capital, became right chancellor of the Secretariat, seized the reins of government, and indulged in wanton cruelty.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Zhizheng, Boluo Temür raised troops and stormed the palace; he then became right chancellor of the Secretariat, grasped the reins of state, and indulged in lewd cruelty at will.

units.zh: 明年七月，孛羅帖木兒入奏事，行至延春閣李樹下，伯顏達兒自眾中奮出，斫孛羅帖木兒，中其腦，上都馬等兢前斫死之。
units.en: In the seventh month of the following year Boluo Temür came in to report on state affairs; as he passed the plum tree below the Yanchun Pavilion, Bayan Da'er burst from the crowd and struck him on the head; Shangdu Ma and the rest rushed in and cut him down.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the following year, Boluo Temür entered to report on affairs; as he reached the plum tree below the Yanchun Pavilion, Bayan Da'er leapt forth from the crowd and hacked Boluo Temür, striking his brain; Shangdu Ma and the others rushed forward together and hacked him to death.

units.zh: 是年六月，福通帥眾攻汴梁，且分軍三道：關先生、破頭潘、馮長舅、沙劉二、王士誠趨晉、冀；
units.en: That June, Futong led his forces against Bianliang and divided them into three columns: Master Guan, Potou Pan, Feng Changjiu, Shaliu Er, and Wang Shicheng marched on Shanxi and Hebei;
units.literal: In the sixth month of that year Futong led his masses to attack Bianliang, and moreover divided his army into three routes: Master Guan, Potou Pan, Feng Changjiu, Shaliu Er, and Wang Shicheng pressed toward Jin and Ji;

units.zh: 二十年，關先生等陷大寧，復犯上都。
units.en: In year 20 (1360), Master Guan and his men took Daning and raided Shangdu again.
units.literal: In the twentieth year Master Guan and the others took Daning and again raided Shangdu.

units.zh: 關先生、破頭潘等又分其軍為二，一出絳州，一出沁州。
units.en: Master Guan, Potou Pan, and the others split their forces again—one column from Jiangzhou, one from Qinzhou.
units.literal: Master Guan, Potou Pan, and the others again divided their army in two—one column out from Jiang Prefecture, one from Qin Prefecture.

units.zh: 時李喜喜、關先生等東西轉戰，已多走死，餘黨自高麗還寇上都，孛羅復擊降之。
units.en: By then Li Xixi, Master Guan, and others had fought across the realm; many had died in flight; remnant bands returning from Goryeo raided Shangdu, and Boluo defeated and accepted their surrender.
units.literal: By then Li Xixi, Master Guan, and the others had fought east and west; many had fled and died; remnant bands returning from Goryeo raided Shangdu, and Boluo again attacked and forced their surrender.

units.zh: 二十一年夏，兩人叛去，降于李思齊。
units.en: In the summer of year 21 (1361), the two defected and surrendered to Li Siqi.
units.literal: In the summer of the twenty-first year the two rebelled and left, surrendering to Li Siqi.

units.zh: 初，朵兒只为集贤学士，从其从兄丞相拜住在上都。
units.en: Earlier, when Duo'erzhi was academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, he followed his cousin by the mother's side, Chief Councilor Baizhu, at the Upper Capital.
units.literal: Earlier, when Duo'erzhi was academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, he followed his cousin by the mother's side, Chief Councilor Baizhu, at the Upper Capital.

units.zh: 南坡之变，拜住遇害。
units.en: In the Nampa Incident Baizhu was killed.
units.literal: In the Nampa Incident, Baizhu met disaster.

units.zh: 拜住，从父也，请于仁宗，降玺书护其家。
units.en: Baizhu, his cousin by the mother's side, asked Emperor Renzong for an imperial letter to protect his household.
units.literal: Baizhu, his cousin by the mother's side, requested of Emperor Renzong, who lowered an imperial letter to protect his household.

units.zh: 乃蛮台，木华黎五世孙。
units.en: Naimantai was a fifth-generation descendant of Muqali.
units.literal: Naimantai was a fifth-generation descendant of Muqali.

units.zh: 田豐者，元鎮守黃河義兵萬戶也，叛附福通，陷濟寧，尋敗走。
units.en: Tian Feng had been a Yuan commander of militia along the Yellow River; he defected to Futong, seized Jining, but was soon defeated and driven off.
units.literal: Tian Feng was a Yuan ten-thousand-household commander of righteous troops guarding the Yellow River; he rebelled and joined Futong, took Jining, and soon was defeated and fled.

units.zh: 元兵急攻益都，穴地道以入，殺豐、士城，而械送猱頭于京師，林兒勢大窘。
units.en: Yuan forces stormed Yidu, tunneled into the city, killed Feng and Shicheng, and sent Yaotou in chains to the capital; Lin'er's position collapsed.
units.literal: Yuan troops pressed the attack on Yidu, tunneled underground to enter, killed Feng and Shicheng, and sent Yaotou in fetters to the capital; Lin'er's position became greatly straitened.

units.zh: 十八年，田豐復陷東平、濟寧、東昌、益都、廣平、順德。
units.en: In year 18 (1358), Tian Feng recaptured Dongping, Jining, Dongchang, Yidu, Guangping, and Shunde.
units.literal: In the eighteenth year Tian Feng again took Dongping, Jining, Dongchang, Yidu, Guangping, and Shunde.

units.zh: 獨田豐據東平，勢稍強。
units.en: Only Tian Feng held Dongping, and his position was somewhat stronger.
units.literal: Only Tian Feng held Dongping, and his power was somewhat stronger.

units.zh: 田豐陷保定，元遣使招之，被殺。
units.en: Tian Feng took Baoding; when the Yuan sent envoys to negotiate, he had them killed.
units.literal: Tian Feng took Baoding; the Yuan sent envoys to summon him, and he had them killed.

units.zh: 元將孛羅敗之於台州，遂入東平與豐合。
units.en: The Yuan general Boluo defeated him at Taizhou; he then entered Dongping and joined Tian Feng.
units.literal: The Yuan general Boluo defeated him at Taizhou; he then entered Dongping and joined forces with Feng.

units.zh: 武宗崩，仁宗立，延祐三年春，議建東宮，時丞相鐵木叠而欲固位取寵，乃議立英宗為皇太子，又與太后幸臣識烈門譖帝於兩宮，浸潤久之，其計遂行。
units.en: Wuzong died; Renzong ascended the throne; spring of the third year of Yanyou, when the Eastern Palace was under deliberation, Chancellor Tiemudie'er, wishing to secure his position and win favor, proposed installing Shidebala as crown prince; together with the empress dowager's favorite minister Shiliemen he slandered him before the two palaces; after long insinuation, the scheme succeeded.
units.literal: Wuzong died; Renzong ascended the throne; spring of the third year of YanYou, when the Eastern Palace was under deliberation, Chancellor Tiemudie'er, wishing to secure his position and win favor, proposed installing Shidebala as crown prince; together with the empress dowager's favorite minister Shiliemen he slandered him before the two palaces; after long insinuation, the scheme succeeded.

units.zh: 延祐七年，仁宗崩，英宗嗣立。
units.en: Seventh year of Yanyou, Renzong died; Shidebala succeeded to the throne.
units.literal: Seventh year of YanYou, Renzong died; Shidebala succeeded to the throne.

units.zh: 至治三年八月癸亥，御史大夫鐵失等弒英宗，晉王也孫鐵木兒自立為皇帝，改元泰定。
units.en: Third year of Zhizhi, eighth month, on guihai day, Censor-in-Chief Tieshi and others assassinated Shidebala; Prince of Jin Yesun Temür installed himself as emperor and changed the reign title to Taiding.
units.literal: Third year of Zhizhi, eighth month, on guihai day, Censor-in-Chief Tieshi and others assassinated Shidebala; Prince of Jin Yesun Temür installed himself as emperor and changed the reign title to Taiding.

units.zh: 又曰：「天下用兵，河北有孛羅帖木兒，河南有擴廓帖木兒，關中有李思齊、張良弼。
units.en: He also said, "Across the realm at war, Hebei has Boluo Temür, Henan has Köke Temür, and Guanzhong has Li Siqi and Zhang Liangbi.
units.literal: He also said: "Under arms across the realm, in Hebei there is Boluo Temür, in Henan there is Köke Temür, and in Guanzhong there are Li Siqi and Zhang Liangbi.

units.zh: 二十五年三月，遂矯制幽於諸色總管府，令其黨姚伯顏不花守之。
units.en: In the third month of the twenty-fifth year he forged an order and had her confined at the Office of the Commissioner for All Colors, ordering his partisan Yao Bayanbuqa to guard her.
units.literal: In the third month of the twenty-fifth year he forged an order and had her confined at the Office of the Commissioner for All Colors, ordering his partisan Yao Bayanbuqa to guard her.

units.zh: 御史大夫老的沙以其事聞，皇太子執不下，而皇后庇之尤固，御史乃皆坐左遷。
units.en: Censor-in-chief Laodasha reported the matter, but the crown prince withheld the memorial. The empress shielded the accused all the more stubbornly, and every censor involved was demoted.
units.literal: Censor-in-Chief Laodasha reported the matter to the throne. The crown prince held the memorial and would not release it, while the empress sheltered them all the more firmly. The censors therefore all suffered demotion to lesser posts.

units.zh: 時老的沙執其事頗力，皇太子因惡之，而皇后又譖之於內，帝以老的沙母舅故，封為雍王，遣歸國。
units.en: Laodasha had pressed the case vigorously, and the crown prince came to dislike him. The empress slandered him within the palace, but because he was the emperor’s uncle on the mother’s side, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Yong and sent home.
units.literal: At that time Laodasha had pursued the matter with considerable force. The crown prince therefore hated him, while the empress also slandered him within. Because Laodasha was the Emperor’s maternal uncle, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Yong and sent back to his domain.

units.zh: 老的沙至大同，遂留孛羅帖木兒軍中。
units.en: Laodasha reached Datong and stayed with Boluo Timur’s army.
units.literal: Laodasha reached Datong and then remained in Boluo Timur’s army.

units.zh: 是時，搠思監、樸不花方倚擴廓帖木兒為外援，怨孛羅帖木兒匿老的沙不遣，遂誣孛羅帖木兒與老的沙謀不軌。
units.en: Bodashirin and Po Buhua were then counting on Köke Temür as their outside ally. Angry that Boluo Timur was sheltering Laodasha, they accused Boluo Timur and Laodasha of plotting rebellion.
units.literal: At this time Bodashirin and Po Buhua were just then relying on Köke Temür as external support. They resented Boluo Timur for harboring Laodasha and not sending him back, and therefore slandered Boluo Timur and Laodasha as plotting treason.

units.zh: 會皇太子撫軍冀寧，承製拜樸賽因不花翰林學士承旨，遷集賢大學士，又為宣政院使，遂拜中書平章政事。
units.en: When the crown prince pacified the army in Jining, Pusaiyin Buhua was appointed by imperial order Hanlin academician-in-ordinary, transferred to grand academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, made commissioner of the Office of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs, and finally appointed chief councillor of the Central Secretariat.
units.literal: When the crown prince pacified the army in Jining, Pusaiyin Buhua was appointed by imperial order Hanlin academician-in-ordinary, transferred to grand academician of the Hall of Gathered Worthies, made commissioner of the Office of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs, and finally appointed chief councillor of the Central Secretariat.

units.zh: 至正二十四年，甘肅行省以孛羅帖木兒矯弒皇后、皇孫，遣人白事，平章政事也速答兒即欲署諭眾榜，樸賽因不花持不可曰： 「此大事，何得輕​​信，況非符驗公文。」
units.en: In 1364 the Gansu Branch Secretariat reported that Bolu Temur had falsely murdered the empress and the imperial grandson and sent someone to inform the court. Chief Councillor Yesudar immediately wished to sign a proclamation to the people. Pusaiyin Buhua objected, saying, "This is a grave matter—how can it be lightly believed, especially when there is no verified official document."
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Zhizheng, the Gansu Branch Secretariat reported that Bolu Temur had falsely murdered the empress and the imperial grandson, and sent someone to inform the court. Chief Councillor Yesudar immediately wished to sign a proclamation to the people. Pusaiyin Buhua held that this would not do and said, "This is a grave matter—how can it be lightly believed, especially when there is no verified official document."

units.zh: 皇太子立大撫軍院，命庸團結房山，遷同僉將作院事，又除刑部尚書，仍領團結。
units.en: The crown prince established the Great Pacification Army Bureau and ordered Yong to organize militia in Fangshan. He was transferred to associate director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, then appointed Minister of Justice while still leading the militia organization.
units.literal: The crown prince established the Great Pacification Army Bureau and ordered Yong to organize militia in Fangshan. He was transferred to associate director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings, then appointed Minister of Justice while still leading the militia organization.

units.zh: 擴廓帖木兒扈從皇太子還京，輸山東粟以遺朝貴，饋好禮麥百石，好禮不受。
units.en: Köke Temür escorted the crown prince back to the capital and sent Shandong grain as gifts to court nobles. He presented Haoli with a hundred piculs of wheat, but Haoli refused it.
units.literal: Köke Temür escorted the crown prince back to the capital and sent Shandong grain as gifts to court nobles. He presented Haoli with a hundred piculs of wheat, but Haoli would not accept.

units.zh: 潁州人劉福通與其党杜遵道、羅文素、盛文鬱等復言「山童，宋徽宗八世孫，當主中國」。
units.en: Liu Futong of Yingzhou and his followers—Du Zundao, Luo Wensu, Sheng Wenyu, and others—again declared, "Shantong is the eighth-generation descendant of Song Huizong and should rule China."
units.literal: Liu Futong of Ying Prefecture and his partisans Du Zundao, Luo Wensu, Sheng Wenyu, and others again declared: "Shantong is the eighth-generation descendant of Emperor Huizong of Song; he should rule China."

units.zh: 至正十一年五月，事覺，福通等遽入潁州反，而山童為吏所捕誅。
units.en: In the fifth month of Zhizheng 11 (1351), the plot was exposed; Futong and his men rose immediately in Yingzhou, while officials captured and executed Shantong.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the eleventh year of Zhizheng the plot was discovered; Futong and the others hastily entered Ying Prefecture in rebellion, while Shantong was seized by officials and executed.

units.zh: 尊楊氏為皇太后，遵道、文郁為丞相，福通、文素平章政事，劉六知樞密院事。
units.en: Lady Yang was honored as Empress Dowager; Zundao and Wenyu became chancellors; Futong and Wensu, Vice Directors of the Secretariat; Liu Liu, Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: Lady Yang was honored as Empress Dowager; Zundao and Wenyu were made chancellors; Futong and Wensu were Vice Directors of the Secretariat; Liu Liu was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 福通嫉之，陰命甲士撾殺遵道，自為丞相，加太保，事權一歸福通。
units.en: Futong, jealous, had armed men beat Zundao to death; he took the chancellorship himself, added the title Grand Guardian, and concentrated all power in his own hands.
units.literal: Futong envied him; secretly he ordered armored soldiers to beat Zundao to death; he himself became chancellor, was additionally made Grand Guardian, and all authority returned to Futong alone.

units.zh: 劉六者，福通弟也。
units.en: Liu Liu was Futong's younger brother.
units.literal: Liu Liu was Futong's younger brother.

units.zh: 遂親帥師往救，而珍已入城殺福通。
units.en: He led the army personally to the rescue, but Lü Zhen had already entered the city and killed Futong.
units.literal: He thereupon personally led troops to the rescue, but Zhen had already entered the city and killed Futong.

units.zh: 然林兒本起盜賊，無大志，又聽命福通，徒擁虛名。
units.en: Yet Lin'er was a bandit chieftain at heart, without grand ambition, and obeyed Futong—holding only a hollow title.
units.literal: Yet Lin'er had originally risen from banditry and had no great ambition; moreover he obeyed Futong's orders and merely held an empty name.

units.zh: 十五年二月，福通物色林兒，得諸碭山夾河；
units.en: In the second month of year 15 (1355), Futong found Lin'er between the rivers at Dangshan;
units.literal: In the second month of the fifteenth year, Futong sought out Lin'er and found him between the rivers at Dangshan;

units.zh: 福通據硃皋，破羅山、上蔡、真陽、確山，犯葉、舞陽，陷汝寧、光、息，眾至十余萬，元兵不能禦。
units.en: Futong seized Zhugao and stormed Luoshan, Shangcai, Zhenyang, Queshan, Ye, and Wuyang, capturing Runing, Guang, and Xi; his forces swelled past a hundred thousand, and Yuan armies could not stop him.
units.literal: Futong held Zhugao, broke Luoshan, Shangcai, Zhenyang, and Queshan, raided Ye and Wuyang, and took Runing, Guang, and Xi; his forces reached more than a hundred thousand, and Yuan troops could not resist.

units.zh: 既而元師大敗福通于太康，進圍亳，福通挾林兒走安豐。
units.en: Soon Yuan forces routed Futong at Taikang and besieged Bo; Futong fled with Lin'er to Anfeng.
units.literal: Before long Yuan troops heavily defeated Futong at Taikang and advanced to besiege Bo; Futong took Lin'er and fled to Anfeng.

units.zh: 其秋，福通兵陷大名，遂自曹、濮陷衛輝。
units.en: That autumn Futong's forces took Daming, then advanced from Cao and Pu to seize Weihui.
units.literal: That autumn Futong's troops took Daming, then from Cao and Pu took Weihui.

units.zh: 而福通出沒河南北，五月攻下汴梁，守將竹貞遁去，遂迎林兒都焉。
units.en: Meanwhile Futong ranged across Henan; in the fifth month he took Bianliang, the defender Zhuzhen fled, and he installed Lin'er as his capital there.
units.literal: Meanwhile Futong ranged north and south of the Henan region; in the fifth month he attacked and took Bianliang; the defending general Zhuzhen fled, and he thereupon welcomed Lin'er to make it his capital.

units.zh: 諸將在外者率不遵約束，所過焚劫，至啖老弱為糧，且皆福通故等夷，福通亦不能制。
units.en: Generals in the field ignored discipline, burning and looting wherever they went—even eating the old and weak for food; as Futong's former equals, they obeyed him no better than he could command them.
units.literal: The generals abroad for the most part did not obey discipline; wherever they passed they burned and plundered, even eating the old and weak for provisions; moreover they were all Futong's former equals, and Futong also could not control them.

units.zh: 福通嘗責李武、崔德逗撓，將罪之。
units.en: Futong once blamed Li Wu and Cui De for foot-dragging and was about to punish them.
units.literal: Futong once blamed Li Wu and Cui De for delay and shirking and was about to punish them.

units.zh: 惟陳猱頭者，獨守益都不下，與福通遙為聲援。
units.en: Only Chen Yaotou held out in Yidu, giving distant support to Futong.
units.literal: Only Chen Yaotou alone held Yidu and would not submit, giving distant mutual support with Futong.

units.zh: 福通自安豐引兵赴援，遇元師于火星埠，大敗走還。
units.en: Futong marched from Anfeng to relieve the siege but was routed at Mars Ford and driven back.
units.literal: Futong led troops from Anfeng to the rescue; he met Yuan forces at Mars Ford, was heavily defeated, and fled back.
